title: Zenith_Ledger
description: Full-stack digital wallet platform built as a Turborepo monorepo. Features user and merchant portals, P2P transfers with atomic PostgreSQL transactions, mock bank on-ramp flow, live currency rates via Socket.io and Redis, and a personal expense calculator, all driven by a single Express.js API with 6 domain modules.

title: Ingressor
description: A production-inspired API Gateway built from scratch. Handles rate limiting, request proxying, authentication and analytics

title: Spill_the_Beans

title: AI-Pass
description: A full-stack web application for submitting text-based tasks, running AI-powered analysis, and viewing structured results.

title: FolioMorph
description: Full-stack app that converts uploaded PDFs into interactive flipbooks with realistic 3D page-flip animations, flip sound effects, and a shareable/embeddable link
